selections_required: Netlify exact owner/team/site and actual Free-plan remaining quota
Exact matching Auth Worker issuer, deployment configuration and D1 database
Publication, remote migration0012 and protected service-key provisioning scope
Owned public DNS/TLS fixture zones and callback receiver, fixture access and cleanup authority
Previous deployment identities or explicit new-site shutdown rollback
Provider request/function logs, retention and drain review
controls: Record disabled initial deployment, package manifest, exact audience/issuer, actual Node22 and public health only.
Enable only selected gateway/claim lane and post a synthetic signed challenge to an owned public fixture; verify exact bytes and original SNI/Host.
Use owned DNS fixtures for public IPv4/IPv6, private-only, mixed answers and public-to-private change; do not connect to unowned private services.
Use controlled wrong-host and untrusted-certificate endpoints; prove receiver observed no HTTP body.
Use owned redirect endpoint; verify no second receiver connection and terminal redirect_refused.
Post the identical request concurrently across instances/cold starts; recover the original Workspace-side uncertainty and verify at most one receiver delivery.
Interrupt claim and callback acknowledgements separately; retain original identity and prove no automatic resend.
Exercise bounded headers/body and slow TLS/body fixtures; verify sockets close by the shared deadline with no payload or credentials in retained logs.
Simulate paused/unavailable provider and inspect current Free-plan quota controls without exhausting quota or purchasing resources; preserve undelivered/unknown receipts.
Disable both lanes and execute the recorded rollback/shutdown; verify public/claim refusals and retain fences.
evidence: sanitized source/package hash and exact deployment/runtime identity
negative-control result per criterion and owned fixture counters
actual provider quota/logging settings without account secrets
original request IDs and reduced receipt states only
stop_policy: Classify executed control, prerequisite wait, transport uncertainty and host-policy rejection separately. Stop after two consecutive executed controls with the same unresolved signature and no new evidence. Keep targeted repairs in this checkpoint; no provider fallback or replacement request escapes an unknown fence.
acceptance_limit: Hosted transport only. Real Events subscription, consent, callback vault, scheduling and actual ChatGPT rendering remain separate task requirements.
